name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Hecherhof
beschreibung: The Hecherhof in Thiersee is run as a farm and offers holiday apartments. The apartment is designed for self-caterers and has a fully equipped kitchen. The Thiersee is within walking distance and invites guests to swim in summer. In winter, guests can travel to nearby ski areas such as Kössen. Animals live on the farm, giving guests an insight into agriculture. The surroundings are quiet and surrounded by forests. Thiersee lies in the Thierseetal and is an ideal starting point for tours into the Brandenberger Alpen.
